<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_WorkAccident" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/work-accident">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_WorkAccident" name="Work Accident">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Insured" name="Insured person" processRef="Process_Insured"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Employer" name="Employer" processRef="Process_Employer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_School" name="School, educational facility or university" processRef="Process_School"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_AccidentInsurer" name="Accident insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PrivateInsurer" name="Private insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Directorate" name="Competent directorate"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LabourInspectorate" name="Labour Inspectorate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InformEmployer" name="Inform employer" sourceRef="SendTask_InformEmployer" targetRef="StartEvent_EmployerReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReportDirectorate" name="Report accident" sourceRef="SendTask_ReportDirectorate" targetRef="Participant_Directorate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReportPrivateInsurer" name="Report accident in writing" sourceRef="SendTask_ReportPrivateInsurer" targetRef="Participant_PrivateInsurer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SelfReportInsurer" name="Report accident" sourceRef="SendTask_ReportAccidentInsurer" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReportLabourInspectorate" name="Report fatality or serious injury" sourceRef="SendTask_ReportLabourInspectorate" targetRef="Participant_LabourInspectorate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EmployerReportInsurer" name="Report accident" sourceRef="SendTask_EmployerReportInsurer" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SchoolReportInsurer" name="Report accident in triplicate" sourceRef="SendTask_SchoolReport" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurer"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Insured" name="Insured person process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Incident" name="Work accident or near miss occurs"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_AssessEvent" name="Assess event type"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Reportable" name="Reportable event?" default="Flow_NotReportable"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NoReport" name="No report required"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_InformEmployer" name="Inform employer immediately"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalReporting" name="Further reporting required?" default="Flow_NoFurtherReporting"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ReportDirectorate" name="Report to competent directorate"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ReportPrivateInsurer" name="Report accident in writing to private insurer immediately (fatalities within three days)"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ReportAccidentInsurer" name="Report accident to accident insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalJoin" name="Reporting completed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Reported" name="Event reported"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IncidentAssess" sourceRef="StartEvent_Incident" targetRef="UserTask_AssessEvent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssessGateway" sourceRef="UserTask_AssessEvent" targetRef="Gateway_Reportable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotReportable" sourceRef="Gateway_Reportable" targetRef="EndEvent_NoReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reportable" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Reportable" targetRef="SendTask_InformEmployer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${isReportable}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InformToAdditional" sourceRef="SendTask_InformEmployer" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalReporting"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToDirectorate" name="Student or schoolchild" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalReporting" targetRef="SendTask_ReportDirectorate">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${isStudentOrSchoolchild}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToPrivateInsurer" name="Private insurance" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalReporting" targetRef="SendTask_ReportPrivateInsurer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${hasPrivateInsurance}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToSelfReport" name="Self-employed" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalReporting" targetRef="SendTask_ReportAccidentInsurer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${isSelfEmployed}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoFurtherReporting" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalReporting" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DirectorateJoin" sourceRef="SendTask_ReportDirectorate" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateJoin" sourceRef="SendTask_ReportPrivateInsurer" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelfJoin" sourceRef="SendTask_ReportAccidentInsurer" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinEnd" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_Reported"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Employer" name="Employer process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_EmployerReceived" name="Accident or near miss reported by employee">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_EmployerReceived"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_RecordDetails" name="Record accident details"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Severity" name="Fatality or serious injury, not reported to emergency services?" default="Flow_NoLabourReport"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ReportLabourInspectorate" name="Report to Labour Inspectorate immediately"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SeverityMerge" name="Severity assessed"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Threshold" name="Insured person killed or unable to work for three days or more?" default="Flow_NoInsurerReport"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_EmployerReportInsurer" name="Report to accident insurance provider within five days"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Reported" name="Accident reported"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Recorded" name="Accident recorded"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RecordToSeverity" sourceRef="StartEvent_EmployerReceived" targetRef="UserTask_RecordDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DetailsToSeverity" sourceRef="UserTask_RecordDetails" targetRef="Gateway_Severity"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToLabourReport" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Severity" targetRef="SendTask_ReportLabourInspectorate">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${isFatalOrSeriousNotReportedToEmergency}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoLabourReport" sourceRef="Gateway_Severity" targetRef="Gateway_SeverityMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LabourToMerge" sourceRef="SendTask_ReportLabourInspectorate" targetRef="Gateway_SeverityMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToThreshold" sourceRef="Gateway_SeverityMerge" targetRef="Gateway_Threshold"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToInsurerReport" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Threshold" targetRef="SendTask_EmployerReportInsurer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${isKilledOrIncapacitatedThreeDays}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoInsurerReport" sourceRef="Gateway_Threshold" targetRef="EndEvent_Recorded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsurerReportEnd" sourceRef="SendTask_EmployerReportInsurer" targetRef="EndEvent_Reported"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_School" name="School process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_SchoolAccident" name="Work accident of insured pupil, student or trainee recorded"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SchoolReport" name="Report accident in triplicate to accident insurance provider within five days"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_SchoolReported" name="Report submitted"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SchoolStart" sourceRef="StartEvent_SchoolAccident" targetRef="SendTask_SchoolReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SchoolEnd" sourceRef="SendTask_SchoolReport" targetRef="EndEvent_SchoolReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_WorkAccident" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/work-accident">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_WorkAccident" name="Work Accident">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Insured" name="Insured person" processRef="Process_Insured"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Employer" name="Employer" processRef="Process_Employer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_School" name="School, educational facility or university" processRef="Process_School"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_AccidentInsurer" name="Accident insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PrivateInsurer" name="Private insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Directorate" name="Competent directorate"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LabourInspectorate" name="Labour Inspectorate"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InformEmployer" name="Inform employer" sourceRef="SendTask_InformEmployer" targetRef="StartEvent_EmployerReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SelfReportInsurer" name="Report accident (self-employed)" sourceRef="SendTask_SelfReportInsurer" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReportDirectorate" name="Report accident" sourceRef="SendTask_ReportDirectorate" targetRef="Participant_Directorate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReportPrivateInsurer" name="Report accident in writing" sourceRef="SendTask_ReportPrivateInsurer" targetRef="Participant_PrivateInsurer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReportLabourInspectorate" name="Report fatality or serious injury" sourceRef="SendTask_ReportLabourInspectorate" targetRef="Participant_LabourInspectorate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EmployerReportInsurer" name="Report accident" sourceRef="SendTask_EmployerReportInsurer" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SchoolReportInsurer" name="Report accident in triplicate" sourceRef="SendTask_SchoolReport" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurer"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Insured" name="Insured person process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_IncidentOccurs" name="Work accident, near miss or safety defect occurs"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_InformEmployer" name="Inform employer immediately"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SelfEmployedCheck" name="Self-employed?" default="Flow_SelfNotSelfEmployed"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SelfReportInsurer" name="Report accident to accident insurance provider in good time"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StudentCheck" name="Student or schoolchild?" default="Flow_NotStudent"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ReportDirectorate" name="Report accident to competent directorate"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PrivateCheck" name="Private insurance?" default="Flow_NoPrivateInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ReportPrivateInsurer" name="Report accident in writing immediately to private insurance provider (fatalities within three days)"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_PrivateInsurerReported" name="Private insurance provider reported"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NoPrivateReport" name="No private insurance report required"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IncidentToInform" sourceRef="StartEvent_IncidentOccurs" targetRef="SendTask_InformEmployer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InformToSelfCheck" sourceRef="SendTask_InformEmployer" targetRef="Gateway_SelfEmployedCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelfEmployed" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_SelfEmployedCheck" targetRef="SendTask_SelfReportInsurer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${isSelfEmployed}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelfNotSelfEmployed" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_SelfEmployedCheck" targetRef="Gateway_StudentCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelfReportToStudentCheck" sourceRef="SendTask_SelfReportInsurer" targetRef="Gateway_StudentCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Student" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_StudentCheck" targetRef="SendTask_ReportDirectorate">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${isStudentOrSchoolchild}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotStudent" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_StudentCheck" targetRef="Gateway_PrivateCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DirectorateToPrivateCheck" sourceRef="SendTask_ReportDirectorate" targetRef="Gateway_PrivateCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateInsurance" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateCheck" targetRef="SendTask_ReportPrivateInsurer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${hasPrivateInsurance}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoPrivateInsurance" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateCheck" targetRef="EndEvent_NoPrivateReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateReportEnd" sourceRef="SendTask_ReportPrivateInsurer" targetRef="EndEvent_PrivateInsurerReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Employer" name="Employer process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_EmployerReceived" name="Accident or near miss reported by employee">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_EmployerReceived"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_LabourCheck" name="Fatality or serious injury, not reported to emergency services?" default="Flow_LabourNotRequired"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ReportLabourInspectorate" name="Report to Labour Inspectorate immediately"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InsurerCheck" name="Insured person killed or unable to work for three days or more?" default="Flow_InsurerNotRequired"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_EmployerReportInsurer" name="Report to accident insurance provider within five days"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_InsurerReportedByEmployer" name="Accident reported to accident insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NoInsurerReport" name="No accident insurance report required"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceivedToLabourCheck" sourceRef="StartEvent_EmployerReceived" targetRef="Gateway_LabourCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LabourRequired" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_LabourCheck" targetRef="SendTask_ReportLabourInspectorate">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${isFatalOrSeriousNotReportedToEmergency}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LabourNotRequired" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_LabourCheck" targetRef="Gateway_InsurerCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LabourReportToInsurerCheck" sourceRef="SendTask_ReportLabourInspectorate" targetRef="Gateway_InsurerCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsurerRequired" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_InsurerCheck" targetRef="SendTask_EmployerReportInsurer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${isKilledOrIncapacitatedThreeDays}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsurerNotRequired" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_InsurerCheck" targetRef="EndEvent_NoInsurerReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsurerReportEnd" sourceRef="SendTask_EmployerReportInsurer" targetRef="EndEvent_InsurerReportedByEmployer"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_School" name="School process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_SchoolAccident" name="Work accident of insured pupil, student or trainee becomes known"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SchoolInjuryCheck" name="Insured person physically injured or killed?" default="Flow_SchoolNoInjury"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SchoolReport" name="Report accident in triplicate to accident insurance provider within five days"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_SchoolReported" name="Report submitted to accident insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_SchoolNoReport" name="No school report required"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SchoolStart" sourceRef="StartEvent_SchoolAccident" targetRef="Gateway_SchoolInjuryCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SchoolInjury" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_SchoolInjuryCheck" targetRef="SendTask_SchoolReport">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${isPhysicallyInjuredOrKilled}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SchoolNoInjury" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_SchoolInjuryCheck" targetRef="EndEvent_SchoolNoReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SchoolReportEnd" sourceRef="SendTask_SchoolReport" targetRef="EndEvent_SchoolReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_WorkAccident" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/work-accident">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_WorkAccident" name="Work Accident">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Insured" name="Insured person" processRef="Process_Insured"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Employer" name="Employer" processRef="Process_Employer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_School" name="School, educational facility or university" processRef="Process_School"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_AccidentInsurer" name="Accident insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PrivateInsurer" name="Private insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Directorate" name="Competent directorate"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LabourInspectorate" name="Labour Inspectorate"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InformEmployer" name="Inform employer immediately" sourceRef="SendTask_InformEmployer" targetRef="StartEvent_EmployerReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SelfReportInsurer" name="Report accident (self-employed)" sourceRef="SendTask_SelfReportInsurer" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReportDirectorate" name="Report accident to directorate" sourceRef="SendTask_ReportDirectorate" targetRef="Participant_Directorate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReportPrivateInsurer" name="Report accident in writing" sourceRef="SendTask_ReportPrivateInsurer" targetRef="Participant_PrivateInsurer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReportPrivateFatality" name="Report fatality within three days" sourceRef="SendTask_ReportPrivateFatality" targetRef="Participant_PrivateInsurer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReportLabourInspectorate" name="Report to Labour Inspectorate" sourceRef="SendTask_ReportLabourInspectorate" targetRef="Participant_LabourInspectorate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EmployerReportInsurer" name="Report to insurer within five days" sourceRef="SendTask_EmployerReportInsurer" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SchoolReportInsurer" name="Report in triplicate within five days" sourceRef="SendTask_SchoolReport" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurer"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Insured" name="Insured person process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_IncidentOccurs" name="Work accident, near miss, serious risk or protection defect discovered"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_InformEmployer" name="Inform employer immediately"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SelfEmployedCheck" name="Self-employed?" default="Flow_SelfNotSelfEmployed"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SelfReportInsurer" name="Report accident to accident insurance provider in good time"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SelfEmployedJoin"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StudentCheck" name="Student or schoolchild?" default="Flow_NotStudent"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ReportDirectorate" name="Report accident to competent directorate"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StudentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PrivateCheck" name="Private insurance?" default="Flow_NoPrivateInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ReportPrivateInsurer" name="Report accident in writing immediately to private insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FatalityCheck" name="Fatality?" default="Flow_NotFatal"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ReportPrivateFatality" name="Report fatality to private insurance provider within three days"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PrivateReportJoin"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_PrivateInsurerReported" name="Private insurance provider reported"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NoPrivateReport" name="No private insurance report required"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IncidentToInform" sourceRef="StartEvent_IncidentOccurs" targetRef="SendTask_InformEmployer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InformToSelfCheck" sourceRef="SendTask_InformEmployer" targetRef="Gateway_SelfEmployedCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelfEmployed" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_SelfEmployedCheck" targetRef="SendTask_SelfReportInsurer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${isSelfEmployed}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelfNotSelfEmployed" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_SelfEmployedCheck" targetRef="Gateway_SelfEmployedJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelfReportToJoin" sourceRef="SendTask_SelfReportInsurer" targetRef="Gateway_SelfEmployedJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelfJoinToStudentCheck" sourceRef="Gateway_SelfEmployedJoin" targetRef="Gateway_StudentCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Student" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_StudentCheck" targetRef="SendTask_ReportDirectorate">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${isStudentOrSchoolchild}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotStudent" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_StudentCheck" targetRef="Gateway_StudentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DirectorateToStudentJoin" sourceRef="SendTask_ReportDirectorate" targetRef="Gateway_StudentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StudentJoinToPrivateCheck" sourceRef="Gateway_StudentJoin" targetRef="Gateway_PrivateCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateInsurance" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateCheck" targetRef="SendTask_ReportPrivateInsurer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${hasPrivateInsurance}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoPrivateInsurance" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateCheck" targetRef="EndEvent_NoPrivateReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateReportToFatalityCheck" sourceRef="SendTask_ReportPrivateInsurer" targetRef="Gateway_FatalityCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fatal" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_FatalityCheck" targetRef="SendTask_ReportPrivateFatality">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${isFatal}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotFatal" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_FatalityCheck" targetRef="Gateway_PrivateReportJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FatalReportToJoin" sourceRef="SendTask_ReportPrivateFatality" targetRef="Gateway_PrivateReportJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateJoinToEnd" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateReportJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_PrivateInsurerReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Employer" name="Employer process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_EmployerReceived" name="Accident, near miss or defect reported by employee">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_EmployerReceived"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_EmployerDutiesSplit"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_LabourSeverityCheck" name="Fatality or serious injury?" default="Flow_NotFatalOrSerious"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EmergencyCheck" name="Reported to emergency services?" default="Flow_NotReportedToEmergency"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ReportLabourInspectorate" name="Report to Labour Inspectorate immediately"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_LabourInspectorateReported" name="Accident reported to Labour Inspectorate"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NoLabourReport" name="No Labour Inspectorate report required"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InsurerCheck" name="Insured person killed or unable to work for three days, in full or in part?" default="Flow_InsurerNotRequired"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_EmployerReportInsurer" name="Report to accident insurance provider within five days"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_InsurerReportedByEmployer" name="Accident reported to accident insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NoInsurerReport" name="No accident insurance report required"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceivedToDutiesSplit" sourceRef="StartEvent_EmployerReceived" targetRef="Gateway_EmployerDutiesSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DutiesToLabourCheck" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployerDutiesSplit" targetRef="Gateway_LabourSeverityCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DutiesToInsurerCheck" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployerDutiesSplit" targetRef="Gateway_InsurerCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FatalOrSerious" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_LabourSeverityCheck" targetRef="Gateway_EmergencyCheck">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${isFatalOrSeriousInjury}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotFatalOrSerious" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_LabourSeverityCheck" targetRef="EndEvent_NoLabourReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReportedToEmergency" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_EmergencyCheck" targetRef="EndEvent_NoLabourReport">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${reportedToEmergencyServices}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotReportedToEmergency" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_EmergencyCheck" targetRef="SendTask_ReportLabourInspectorate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LabourReportEnd" sourceRef="SendTask_ReportLabourInspectorate" targetRef="EndEvent_LabourInspectorateReported"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsurerYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_InsurerCheck" targetRef="SendTask_EmployerReportInsurer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${isKilledOrIncapacitatedThreeDays}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsurerNotRequired" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_InsurerCheck" targetRef="EndEvent_NoInsurerReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsurerReportEnd" sourceRef="SendTask_EmployerReportInsurer" targetRef="EndEvent_InsurerReportedByEmployer"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_School" name="School process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_SchoolAccident" name="Work accident of insured pupil, student or trainee becomes known"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SchoolInjuryCheck" name="Insured person physically injured or killed?" default="Flow_SchoolNoInjury"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SchoolReport" name="Report accident in triplicate to accident insurance provider within five days"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_SchoolReported" name="Report submitted to accident insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_SchoolNoReport" name="No school report required"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SchoolStart" sourceRef="StartEvent_SchoolAccident" targetRef="Gateway_SchoolInjuryCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SchoolInjury" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_SchoolInjuryCheck" targetRef="SendTask_SchoolReport">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${isPhysicallyInjuredOrKilled}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SchoolNoInjury" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_SchoolInjuryCheck" targetRef="EndEvent_SchoolNoReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SchoolReportEnd" sourceRef="SendTask_SchoolReport" targetRef="EndEvent_SchoolReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_WorkAccident" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/work-accident">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_WorkAccident" name="Work Accident">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Insured" name="Insured person" processRef="Process_Insured"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Employer" name="Employer" processRef="Process_Employer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_School" name="School, educational facility or university" processRef="Process_School"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_AccidentInsurer" name="Accident insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PrivateInsurer" name="Private insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Directorate" name="Competent directorate"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LabourInspectorate" name="Labour Inspectorate"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InformEmployer" name="Inform employer" sourceRef="SendTask_InformEmployer" targetRef="StartEvent_EmployerReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SelfReportInsurer" name="Report accident (self-employed)" sourceRef="SendTask_SelfReportInsurer" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReportDirectorate" name="Report accident" sourceRef="SendTask_ReportDirectorate" targetRef="Participant_Directorate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReportPrivateInsurer" name="Report accident in writing" sourceRef="SendTask_ReportPrivateInsurer" targetRef="Participant_PrivateInsurer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RepeatPrivateReport" name="Report fatality again" sourceRef="SendTask_RepeatPrivateReport" targetRef="Participant_PrivateInsurer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReportLabourInspectorate" name="Report accident" sourceRef="SendTask_ReportLabourInspectorate" targetRef="Participant_LabourInspectorate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EmployerReportInsurer" name="Report accident" sourceRef="SendTask_EmployerReportInsurer" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SchoolReportInsurer" name="Report accident in triplicate" sourceRef="SendTask_SchoolReport" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurer"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Insured" name="Insured person process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_IncidentOccurs" name="Work accident, near miss, serious risk or protection defect occurs"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_InformEmployer" name="Inform employer">
      <bpmn:documentation>Inform the employer immediately of any work accident, near miss, serious and immediate risk to safety and health, or defect in protection systems.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SelfEmployedCheck" name="Self-employed?" default="Flow_SelfEmployedNo"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SelfReportInsurer" name="Report accident to accident insurance provider">
      <bpmn:documentation>Report in good time, covering accidents involving the self-employed person and persons they employ.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SelfEmployedJoin" name="Self-employed check merged"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StudentCheck" name="Student or schoolchild?" default="Flow_StudentNo"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ReportDirectorate" name="Report accident to competent directorate"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StudentJoin" name="Student check merged"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PrivateCheck" name="Private insurance?" default="Flow_PrivateNo"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ReportPrivateInsurer" name="Report accident in writing to private insurance provider">
      <bpmn:documentation>Report in writing immediately, in line with the policy conditions, to avoid release from the obligation to perform.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FatalityCheck" name="Fatalities?" default="Flow_FatalityNo"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_RepeatPrivateReport" name="Report accident again to private insurance provider">
      <bpmn:documentation>Fatalities must be reported within three days, even if the accident has already been reported.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_PrivateInsurerReported" name="Accident reported to private insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_PrivateFatalityReported" name="Fatality reported again to private insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NoPrivateReport" name="No private insurance report required"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IncidentToInform" sourceRef="StartEvent_IncidentOccurs" targetRef="SendTask_InformEmployer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InformToSelfCheck" sourceRef="SendTask_InformEmployer" targetRef="Gateway_SelfEmployedCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelfEmployedYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_SelfEmployedCheck" targetRef="SendTask_SelfReportInsurer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${isSelfEmployed}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelfEmployedNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_SelfEmployedCheck" targetRef="Gateway_SelfEmployedJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelfReportToJoin" sourceRef="SendTask_SelfReportInsurer" targetRef="Gateway_SelfEmployedJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelfJoinToStudentCheck" sourceRef="Gateway_SelfEmployedJoin" targetRef="Gateway_StudentCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StudentYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_StudentCheck" targetRef="SendTask_ReportDirectorate">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${isStudentOrSchoolchild}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StudentNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_StudentCheck" targetRef="Gateway_StudentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DirectorateToJoin" sourceRef="SendTask_ReportDirectorate" targetRef="Gateway_StudentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StudentJoinToPrivateCheck" sourceRef="Gateway_StudentJoin" targetRef="Gateway_PrivateCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateCheck" targetRef="SendTask_ReportPrivateInsurer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${hasPrivateInsurance}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateCheck" targetRef="EndEvent_NoPrivateReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateReportToFatalityCheck" sourceRef="SendTask_ReportPrivateInsurer" targetRef="Gateway_FatalityCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FatalityYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_FatalityCheck" targetRef="SendTask_RepeatPrivateReport">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${isFatality}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FatalityNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_FatalityCheck" targetRef="EndEvent_PrivateInsurerReported"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepeatToEnd" sourceRef="SendTask_RepeatPrivateReport" targetRef="EndEvent_PrivateFatalityReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Employer" name="Employer process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_EmployerReceived" name="Work accident or near miss reported by insured person">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_EmployerReceived"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_EmployerSplit" name="Employer duties"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_LabourCheck" name="Fatality or serious injury, not reported to emergency services?" default="Flow_LabourNo"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ReportLabourInspectorate" name="Report accident to Labour Inspectorate">
      <bpmn:documentation>Report immediately.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_LabourInspectorateReported" name="Accident reported to Labour Inspectorate"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NoLabourReport" name="No Labour Inspectorate report required"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InsurerCheck" name="Insured person killed or unable to work for three days?" default="Flow_InsurerNo"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_EmployerReportInsurer" name="Report accident to accident insurance provider">
      <bpmn:documentation>Report within five days.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_InsurerReportedByEmployer" name="Accident reported to accident insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NoInsurerReport" name="No accident insurance report required"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceivedToSplit" sourceRef="StartEvent_EmployerReceived" targetRef="Gateway_EmployerSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToLabourCheck" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployerSplit" targetRef="Gateway_LabourCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToInsurerCheck" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployerSplit" targetRef="Gateway_InsurerCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LabourYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_LabourCheck" targetRef="SendTask_ReportLabourInspectorate">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${isFatalOrSeriousNotReportedToEmergency}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LabourNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_LabourCheck" targetRef="EndEvent_NoLabourReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LabourReportEnd" sourceRef="SendTask_ReportLabourInspectorate" targetRef="EndEvent_LabourInspectorateReported"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsurerYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_InsurerCheck" targetRef="SendTask_EmployerReportInsurer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${isKilledOrIncapacitatedThreeDays}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsurerNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_InsurerCheck" targetRef="EndEvent_NoInsurerReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsurerReportEnd" sourceRef="SendTask_EmployerReportInsurer" targetRef="EndEvent_InsurerReportedByEmployer"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_School" name="School process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_SchoolAccident" name="Work accident of insured pupil, student or trainee becomes known"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SchoolInjuryCheck" name="Insured person physically injured or killed?" default="Flow_SchoolNoInjury"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SchoolReport" name="Report accident in triplicate to accident insurance provider">
      <bpmn:documentation>Report within a maximum of five days, in triplicate.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_SchoolReported" name="Accident reported to accident insurance provider by school"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_SchoolNoReport" name="No school report required"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SchoolStart" sourceRef="StartEvent_SchoolAccident" targetRef="Gateway_SchoolInjuryCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SchoolInjury" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_SchoolInjuryCheck" targetRef="SendTask_SchoolReport">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${isPhysicallyInjuredOrKilled}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SchoolNoInjury" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_SchoolInjuryCheck" targetRef="EndEvent_SchoolNoReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SchoolReportEnd" sourceRef="SendTask_SchoolReport" targetRef="EndEvent_SchoolReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description states several distinct outcomes that each end in a report to a different recipient or authority, and the reporting wording is the same or nearly the same across those outcomes: Create one bpmn:endEvent per distinct outcome. Build each end event's xs:ID from the specific recipient and condition that outcome represents, not from the shared reporting wording. Before finishing, check every id attribute in the model, including those of end events, tasks, gateways and sequence flows, and make sure no id value appears more than once.
rules.situation: the description states several distinct outcomes that each end in a report to a different recipient or authority, and the reporting wording is the same or nearly the same across those outcomes

rules.instruction: When the description makes the reporting deadline or the recipient of an event depend on a sequence of yes/no checks on that event (for example whether it was fatal, whether it meets a stated severity or duration threshold, and whether another party already received a report), and each check changes the next step: Model each check as its own exclusive gateway, placed in the order the description gives the checks. Give each gateway one labelled outgoing flow per outcome, using the condition wording from the description. Attach each outcome flow to the report or step it triggers, including any stated deadline. Route the not-taken outcome to the next check or to its own continuation. Do not replace these checks with a task that assesses the event, and do not drop a check because its outcome only changes a deadline.
rules.situation: the description makes the reporting deadline or the recipient of an event depend on a sequence of yes/no checks on that event (for example whether it was fatal, whether it meets a stated severity or duration threshold, and whether another party already received a report), and each check changes the next step

rules.instruction: When the description attaches to one occurrence a reporting duty and then a further reporting duty that it introduces as applying independently of the first, each with its own check, recipient or deadline: Model each duty as its own branch that leaves the occurrence separately. Place that duty's checks and its report task on its own branch, in the order the description gives. Do not nest the second duty behind the first duty's report, check or deadline, and do not let one gateway join the checks of both duties. Attach any stated time limit to the report task it governs.
rules.situation: the description attaches to one occurrence a reporting duty and then a further reporting duty that it introduces as applying independently of the first, each with its own check, recipient or deadline

rules.instruction: When the description attaches a reporting duty with its own deadline or recipient to a subset of occurrences defined by a stated outcome, and a general duty to report the same occurrences also applies: Model an exclusive gateway whose question states the outcome condition in the description's own terms, not the actor's status or another condition. Place the subset's report task on the branch where that outcome holds, labelled with the stated recipient and deadline. Label the general report task with the duty's own recipient and timing as the description states them, and do not replace the outcome condition with the actor's role in any label.
rules.situation: the description attaches a reporting duty with its own deadline or recipient to a subset of occurrences defined by a stated outcome, and a general duty to report the same occurrences also applies

rules.instruction: When the description makes the time limit or the target of a follow-up action depend on a sequence of yes/no checks applied to the same subject, where each check's result changes the next step: Model each check as its own exclusive gateway, placed in the order the description gives the checks. Give each gateway one labelled outgoing flow per outcome, using the condition wording from the description. Attach each outcome flow to the action or step it triggers, including any stated time limit. Connect the not-taken outcome to the next check or to its own continuation. Do not replace these checks with a single task that assesses the subject, and do not omit a check merely because its outcome only changes a time limit.
rules.situation: the description makes a notification to an authority depend on several yes/no checks applied to the same occurrence, such as the stated outcome, a stated cover or status of the affected party, and whether the event was already reported to another authority, and the description joins two or more of these checks in one sentence

rules.instruction: When the description states a reporting duty for an occurrence, and then states that a subset of the same occurrence (defined by a stated outcome) must be reported again with its own shorter deadline even though it has already been reported: Model the general report and the repeat report as two separate tasks in sequence. Place the repeat report after the general report, on the branch of an exclusive gateway whose question states the outcome condition in the description's own terms. Label each task with only its verb, object and recipient as the description names them. Record the repeat report's own deadline and its 'even if already reported' qualification in the documentation of that task, and do not place the outcome condition or the deadline in either task label.
rules.situation: the description states a reporting duty for an occurrence, and then states that a subset of the same occurrence (defined by a stated outcome) must be reported again with its own shorter deadline even though it has already been reported
